Metadata.title: StoryFlop — Scrum Poker for Agile Teams
Metadata.description: Estimate user stories and story points together with real-time Scrum Poker. Put every story on the table, reveal the cards and reach consensus.

Brand.claim: Put every story on the table, reveal the cards and reach consensus.

Home.lead: Put every story on the table, reveal the cards and reach consensus.
Home.createDetail: Creating a room takes less than a minute.
Home.joinDetail: Paste the 8-character code from your invitation.
Home.privacy: No registration. Your session is stored anonymously.
Home.footerTime: Built for teams that value their time.
Home.footerShare: Share a link and get started.
